info.title: Node.js script to expand 1-10 and a-z ranges

diffs.patch:
Index: package.json
===================================================================
--- package.json	
+++ package.json	
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+{
+  "name": "range-expand",
+  "version": "1.0.0",
+  "description": "Expand ranges like 1-10 or a-z into an array of all values in between",
+  "type": "module",
+  "main": "src/index.js",
+  "bin": {
+    "range-expand": "bin/cli.js"
+  },
+  "scripts": {
+    "start": "node bin/cli.js",
+    "test": "node --test"
+  },
+  "license": "MIT"
+}

Index: src/index.js
===================================================================
--- src/index.js	
+++ src/index.js	
@@ -0,0 +1,1 @@
+export { expandRange } from './expandRange.js';

parts.text:
Project set up and all 8 tests pass.

- `src/expandRange.js` — `expandRange('1-10')` → numbers, `expandRange('a-z')` → letters; supports descending and multi-digit ranges, throws on invalid input.
- `src/index.js` — re-exports.
- `bin/cli.js` — `npm start -- 1-10`.
- `test/expandRange.test.js` — run with `npm test`.
